caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular mantel clock made primarily of dark wood with decorative carvings at the top, including a central floral or foliage motif flanked by two finials. The clock face is circular with a white background, black Arabic numerals from 1 to 12, black minute and hour hands, and a smaller second hand. The face is set in a square frame with each corner displaying a triangular decorative design in red, green, and gold tones. Below the clock face, there is a section featuring a glass window through which a pendulum and some gold and white painted decorative designs are visible. The main body of the clock is supported by two twisted columns on either side. At the bottom of the clock, another glass panel is present, showing a painted gold wreath encircling an oval shape. The clock sits on a simple rectangular base. The entire drawing is bordered by a thin line forming a rectangle around the clock. In the bottom right corner, there is a small line drawing showing the side profile and dimensions of the clock. The background of the image is a plain, cream-colored paper. At the bottom left of the sheet, text reads “R. Morton Del. 239-1” and at the bottom right, the word “CLOCK” is written.
title: Clock
